## Activity

During February 2020, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 348 captures. This represents the total activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below. Capture activity should continue to be monitored through routine site reporting so that changes in workload or performance can be identified promptly.

## Image quality

Of the 348 captures, 21 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.0. These images could not be used for grading, and the result should be reviewed as part of the clinic’s ongoing quality assurance arrangements. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk to support follow-up and resolution.

## Grading

Grading identified 72 referable results. The median lag between image capture and completion of grading was 1 day. This measure should be considered alongside the referable result count when reviewing service timeliness. Continued attention to image quality, equipment problems and grading turnaround will support reliable reporting and appropriate referral processes at Harbour Eye Clinic.
